facts.title: Clerk filing and public research links
facts.summary: Clerk directs attorneys to mandatory statewide Portal filing and permits self-represented paper filing. Page discourages duplicate paper copies but separately directs certain original documents to paper filing; retain that scope and linked-source mismatch. Records page separately routes court records and official land/recorded documents. Three county navigation resources identified: Official Records, Court Records, Tax Assessor.
